subject: english
question: Select the central theme of the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Understanding liberty'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The central theme of the passage is: **'Understanding liberty'.**
 
• As this is clearly mentioned in the passage:** '****However, it is essential to emphasise that there should be checks and balances in Freedom. Additionally, unrestricted freedom can result in serious consequences. Who hasn't heard of promising young people running away from their studies? In the same way, we should remember that granting someone freedom does not mean removing the safety net that will catch them if they fall. Numerous teenage criminals have slipped through social networks without being observed. In general, it might be preferable to restrict teenagers' freedom so that they can become more responsible adults in adulthood'. **

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Family relationships'** is not the central theme according to the passage.
 
• **'Work job stress'** is not the central theme according to the passage.
 
• **'Learning and environment'** is not the central theme according to the passage.
